description:
GPU-Z is a lightweight system utility designed to provide vital information about your video card and graphics processor.

GPU-Z is a lightweight system utility designed to provide vital information about your video card and graphics processor.
Main Features
- Supports NVIDIA, AMD, ATI and Intel graphics devices
- Displays adapter, GPU and display information
- Displays overclock, default clocks and 3D/boost clocks (if available)
- Detailed reporting on memory subsystem: memory size, type, speed, bus width
- Includes a GPU load test to verify PCI-Express lane configuration
- Validation of results
- GPU-Z can create a backup of your graphics card BIOS
- No installation required, optional installer is available
- Support for Windows 11 / Windows 10 / Windows 8 / Windows 7 / Vista / Windows XP (both 32 and 64 bit versions are supported)
- .. and yes, the author of CPU-Z has granted us permission to use a name similar to his product. Thanks Franck.
- Added support for NVIDIA RTX Spark (some memory details still missing)
- Added tooltip that shows sensor value statistics when hovering over the sensor's number display
- On integrated GPUs, instead of "N/A", system memory is now shown as memory size: "iGPU (64 GB)"
- Unknown NVIDIA power rails are now included in sensors as 'Rail xxx Power Draw' (disabled by default)
- Unknown GPUs will now probe DirectX support from the running system instead of showing 'Unknown'
- Added support for clock and temperature monitoring on some AMD iGPUs
- Sensor min/max/avg no longer include invalid sensor readings in the calculation
- Added support for reading hotspot temperature on AMD R9 200/300, Fury and RX 400/500 Series (Polaris, Lexa, Hawaii, Fiji, Bonaire, Tonga)
- The Hot Spot thermal sensor is now named 'Hot Spot' on both AMD and NVIDIA
- Fixed OpenGL detection sometimes not working
- Fixed various typos and small errors in Advanced -> CUDA
- Added names for more DXVA GUIDs for AMD and NVIDIA
- Fixed DXVA detection for 8K support
- Added support for CUDA Capabilities 6.2, 7.x, 8.x, 9.0, 10.x and 12.x and several new CUDA attributes
- Advanced tab: don't show corrupted 'NVIDIA BIOS' section if the BIOS can't be read at all
- Added support for AMD BC-250 mining GPU
- Added support for NVIDIA RTX 5070 (GB203) and RTX 4090 Ti ES
- Added support for Intel Raptor Lake-H Refresh and Iris Pro P555 (E3-1558L v5)
